==Ingredients==
*1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (360 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) short grain [[Cookbook:rice|rice]], cooked
*4 [[Cookbook:Spring Onion|spring onions]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*3 [[Cookbook:egg|eggs]], lightly beaten
*½ cup (120 ml) grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|parmesan]] cheese
*500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (1 lb) [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], [[Cookbook:Cauliflower|cauliflower]], and [[Cookbook:Broccoli|broccoli]]
*1½ cups (260 ml) [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] [[Cookbook:Mozzarella|mozzarella]] cheese
*1½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] dried [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
*1 cup (240 ml) [[Cookbook:Salsa|tomato salsa]], for serving

==Procedure==
#In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, spring onions, eggs and the Parmesan cheese. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
#Press half the rice mixture into a greased 20 cm [[Cookbook:Springform Pan|spring-form pan]]. [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] vegetables with one cup of mozzarella cheese, place into pan. Spoon on the remaining rice and press down firmly. Sprinkle evenly with remaining cheese and thyme.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a preheated [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 200°C (400°F) for 30–35 minutes.
#Serve with tomato salsa.

Press half the rice mixture into a greased 20 cm spring-form pan. Toss vegetables with one cup of mozzarella cheese, place into pan. Spoon on the remaining rice and press down firmly. Sprinkle evenly with remaining cheese and thyme.
